widget.doc: A drawn picture where a photo would go (never use an image URL): kind is a product or food (shoe, mug, tote, box, beans, laptop, banana, milk, bread, eggs, cheese, apple) on a toned ground, or a travel scene (mountain, harbor, skyline, dunes, forest, lagoon, market, festival, train, temple, bamboo); tone recolors it (products: sand, rose, mint, sky, lilac, slate; scenes: dawn, day, dusk, night); size it with h (and w).

props.doc: What is drawn. Products and food on a toned ground: shoe, mug, tote, box, beans, laptop, banana, milk, bread, eggs, cheese, apple. Travel scenes: mountain, harbor, skyline, dunes, forest, lagoon, market, festival, train, temple, bamboo.
The palette. For a product: sand, rose, mint, sky, lilac or slate. For a scene, the time of day: dawn, day, dusk or night. auto picks one per kind.
Rounded corners (false when a parent clips it).
